---
name: Feature Request
about: Suggest a new feature or improvement for ROEDEX
title: "[FEAT] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: LordCyberr
---

## Feature Summary
A clear and concise description of the feature you'd like to see.

## Problem It Solves
What problem does this feature address? What are you trying to do that you can't do now?
> Example: "I'm always frustrated when I have to manually track X because..."

## Proposed Solution
How do you imagine this feature working? Feel free to be creative.

## Alternatives Considered
Are there any alternative approaches or workarounds you've considered?

## Visual Reference (Optional)
Mockups, sketches, or screenshots from similar tools are very helpful.

## Priority / Impact
How important is this to your gameplay or workflow?
- [ ] 🔥 High — I need this to use ROEDEX effectively
- [ ] ⚡ Medium — Would significantly improve my experience
- [ ] 💡 Low — Nice to have, not urgent

## Additional Context
Any other notes, game version details, or context that might help.
